english.legislation: Contrary to section 196C(2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

english.notes:
(i) In relation to options A and B:-
Section 196A(3) the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 provides, "The Secretary of State shall not so authorise any person without consulting the local planning authority."and;
Section 196A(4) of the Act provides, "The admission to any building used as a dwellinghouse shall not be demanded as of right by virtue of section 196A(1) or (2) unless twenty-four hours' notice of the intended entry has been given to the occupier of the building."
(ii) In relation to option C:-
Section 196B(3) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 provides, "A warrant authorises entry on one occasion only and that entry must be within one month from the date of the issue of the warrant and at a reasonable hour, unless the case is one of urgency."
